observations: Photo shows a large white chest freezer with a metal lid and latch.
A label on the front reads '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION' and '2 YEARS WARRANTY' (brand name not clearly readable).
No visible brand/model name is readable from the photo.
No clear view of power rating, voltage, compressor type, or any control panel.

claims.evidence: Photo does not show a capacity figure (liters) clearly.
Photo does not show voltage range/specs or a 'low voltage' rating.
Photo label on the freezer front states '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION'.
No photo/video of it running, temperature reading, or compressor operation.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: Photo does not show purchase date, receipt, warranty card, or whether the motor was opened.

risks.risk: Capacity/size may not match 250L (affects market price).
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/spec label showing capacity (liters) and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic chest freezer of unknown capacity (worst-case: smaller/less valuable unit).

risks.risk: May not actually be working (compressor/thermostat/fan/relay issues).
risks.proof: Short video of it plugged in and running (compressor sound + indicator/thermostat setting), plus a thermometer reading after cooling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Voltage compatibility may be wrong for Rivers power (could trip/struggle).
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate showing input voltage range (e.g., 110–240V or specific V) and any 'low voltage' spec.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard-voltage unit (worst-case: not suitable for low voltage without stabilizer).

risks.risk: Cooling retention claim may be marketing; insulation seals/gaskets may be leaking.
risks.proof: Photo of door gasket condition + test: close door and show temperature drop over time (or IR/door seal check).
risks.if_unproven: Price as reduced performance (worst-case: gasket leak/poor retention).

risks.risk: Brand/model not readable; wrong identity can lead to wrong pricing.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the brand/model nameplate (usually on side/back or inside lid frame).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic chest freezer without brand premium.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate showing brand, model, capacity (liters), and voltage range.
Video showing the freezer running (compressor on) and a thermometer reading after it cools.
Photo of the door gasket and inside lid area (to check seal condition).
Photos of receipt and warranty card (with dates/serial number).
response.reason: The photo supports only the '120 hours cooling retention' label, but key pricing drivers (exact capacity, brand/model, voltage compatibility, and confirmed working status) are not verifiable remotely. To price safely in Rivers, Nigeria, request the rating plate and a running/temperature proof.
